notes.title: Demo update with visual improvements and new features
notes.content: [p]The new demo update for Mangut is live! :) [/p][list][*][p]We redesigned the first stage to improve visual clarity and consistency [/p][/*][*][p]A visual effect was added to the bullet time mechanic [/p][/*][*][p]The demo now includes a save system so you can resume where you left off [/p][/*][*][p]We made significant tuning to the grappling hook and aiming system [/p][/*][*][p]Multiple bugs were fixed for a smoother experience[/p][/*][/list]
